slides.body: Anne Steele died on November 11, 1778, in Broughton, England. She was 61, and sick for most of her life.
In 1760 she published her hymns, honest ones about sorrow and “fainting hope.” She signed them “Theodosia”: gift of God.

slides.meaning: hymnals have printed her prayer about what God withholds
slides.comparison: “Father, whate’er of earthly bliss,” from her 1760 poems
slides.source: Source: Hymnary.org index, Nov 2026 · Tier A
